title: File:The Matterley Bowl (geograph 2836792).jpg
claims: The image shows the grassy bowl of Matterley Bowl: a mown green field in the hollow, an earth or chalk track along the lower slope, a belt of trees and a ploughed field on the rim, under a blue sky with scattered cloud.
